description: This file defines the base class 'SugarClass' and related utility classes 'SugarContainer' and 'SugarDateTime' for the SuiteCRM project. It includes inheritance setup, date/time utilities, and class prototypes, serving as a foundational JavaScript source file.

classes.name: SugarClass
classes.description: Superclass for all Sugar* subclasses, providing inheritance and utility methods.

classes.name: SugarContainer
classes.description: Root class for Sugar JS Application, manages container initialization and startup.

classes.name: SugarDateTime
classes.description: Provides date and time utilities, including parsing and formatting functions.

methods.name: SugarContainer.prototype.init
methods.description: Initializes the container with a root div.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.mysql2jsDateTime
methods.description: Converts MySQL date/time strings to JavaScript Date object.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.prototype.getFormattedDate
methods.description: Formats a date object into a string based on user preferences.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.prototype.getFormattedDOW
methods.description: Returns the day of week in a formatted string.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.getAMPM
methods.description: Returns 'AM' or 'PM' based on the hour of a date object.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.prototype.parseUTCDate
methods.description: Parses a UTC date string into a JavaScript Date object.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.prototype.parseAdjustedDate
methods.description: Parses a date string with DST and GMT offset adjustments.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.prototype.getUTCHash
methods.description: Creates a hash string based on a date's UTC components.
